scenes.name: Ember

scenes.name: Skyline

scenes.name: Nebula

scenes.name: Koi

scenes.name: Sema

scenes.name: Papercut
scenes.blurb: Seven sheets of cut paper; every ridge rises and falls with its own band

scenes.name: Garden

scenes.name: Meadow
scenes.blurb: A perspective field of twelve thousand grass blades and wildflowers; bass sends wind across the hills

scenes.name: Frost

scenes.name: Lale

scenes.name: Synchrony

scenes.name: Infinity
scenes.blurb: A mirror room of hanging lamps, after Kusama; every beat sends a wave out through the reflections

scenes.name: Moonwake

scenes.name: Hamam

scenes.name: Dilek Fenerleri

scenes.name: Gün Batımı

scenes.name: Kuyruklu Yıldız
scenes.blurb: A great comet across a moonless sky: its dust tail lights striation by striation, the bass swells its head, and every beat bursts meteors from the radiant

scenes.name: Yıldız İzleri
scenes.blurb: Star trails round the pole star: the louder the song, the longer the exposure, the rings light zone by zone, and every beat sends a ring of light across them

scenes.name: Buz Mağarası

scenes.name: Çay Ocağı

scenes.name: Deniz Feneri

scenes.name: Denizanası

scenes.name: Dönme Dolap

scenes.name: Fırlatma

scenes.name: Kamp Ateşi

scenes.name: Kütüphane

scenes.name: Vinyl

scenes.name: Cassette
scenes.blurb: Clear-shell tape winding reel to reel, title on the label, hubs glow with bass

scenes.name: Lava

scenes.name: Broadcast

scenes.name: Neon

scenes.name: Arcade

scenes.name: Globe

scenes.name: Pool

scenes.name: Plasma

scenes.name: Mercury

scenes.name: Kilim

scenes.name: Nazar

scenes.name: Chladni

scenes.name: Ebru

scenes.name: Radar

scenes.name: Keys

scenes.name: Mandala

scenes.name: Strings
scenes.blurb: Twenty-four strings blurred into standing waves, bass at the left

scenes.name: Tesseract

scenes.name: Topo

scenes.name: Circuit
